text: Civil engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that studies the investigation, design, construction, maintenance and management of various engineering facilities. Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to build safe, durable, economical and socially-demanding infrastructure in the natural environment". From the pyramids to the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, from ancient water conservancy projects to modern high-speed rail networks, civil engineering has always been the core force for human to transform nature and promote social development, and is hailed as "the basic discipline of the national economy".
